review_scope: Full clip:4.8s overview and1.0s fine-frame samples throughout, with labelled actual PTS; no paid visual model.

observations.label: Opening side-on shoe contact, tilt/lift and return
observations.evidence: Bothshoes start at the floor; one shoe angles/lifts and returns. Head/torso cropped.

observations.label: Oblique free-shoe lift and return
observations.evidence: Free shoe rises behind/beside the other leg; both shoes are later back at the floor.

observations.label: Front/oblique forward motion and later raised shoe
observations.evidence: Working shoe moves forward, returns, and is later raised behind the support leg.

observations.label: Orientation/contact variation
observations.evidence: Shoes turn, cross or extend close to the floor; angled heels/soles and returns visible.

observations.label: Later working-shoe forward/across motions
observations.evidence: Raised and extended shoe positions alternate with returns near the other shoe.

observations.label: Faster front-view stepping
observations.evidence: Relative shoe positions change rapidly; blur limits contact identification.

observations.label: Lower-camera shoe motion
observations.evidence: Raised soles/feet and returns near the floor visible; no whole-body view.

observations.label: Wider crop free-foot lift
observations.evidence: One shoe rises behind the supporting leg and returns in the wider crop; head remains outside frame.

observations.label: Wider travelling/crossed-foot sequence
observations.evidence: Performer changesfloor position, crosses shoes/legs, and shows separated/grounded positions.

observations.label: Blank source ending
observations.evidence: White/blank image is a source edit; no visible performance evidence.
